prompt: In explaining what determines the amount of ozone in the stratosphere, the author describes natural processes that form

options.text: an interactive relationship
a reductive system
a linear progression
a set of randomly occurring phenomena
a set of sporadically recurring events

explanation: 正確答案為 A（an interactive relationship）。作者描述生成與破壞同時進行：陽光既製造又分解臭氧，氮氧化物加速分解，風再把臭氧帶離赤道，各過程相互作用決定總量，屬交互關係。D、E 的隨機、零星與文中「continuously」的描述相反；C 的線性過程也不符合循環平衡。

source.title: GRE 閱讀 300 篇 · 授權內容

prompt: Having written 140 books to date, he may well be considered one of the most ______ novelists of the century.

options.text: eccentric
controversial
easygoing
unheralded
prolific

explanation: 正確答案為 “prolific”。線索是「Having written 140 books to date」：著作量驚人，所以是最多產的小說家之一。prolific（多產的）最合適。controversial 或 eccentric 雖然文法可通，卻與作品數量的線索無關；unheralded（未受讚揚的）也沒有依據。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Though he was a highly skilled computer programmer, he showed little or no ______ in designing educational software.

options.text: emotion
opportunity
structure
competition
creativity

explanation: 正確答案為 “creativity”。Though he was a highly skilled programmer 讓步：技術高超卻在設計教育軟體上缺乏 creativity（創造力）。structure 與 opportunity 不構成與 skilled 的對比；emotion 與軟體設計無關。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Though Socrates was ______ by his students, who found truth in his teachings, his philosophy constituted a threat to the existing government. Consequently, with the extreme position of completely destroying Socrates’ position and philosophy, angry officials sought to ______ the value of Socrates’ premises.

options.text: revered
slighted
vilified
challenge
undermine
acknowledge

explanation: 正確答案為 revered、undermine。Though 形成讓步：學生在他的教導中找到真理，因此他受到學生「尊崇」（revered），但其哲學卻威脅政府。後半說憤怒的官員採取「徹底摧毀」的極端立場，要「削弱、破壞」他的論點價值，undermine 最貼切。slighted 與 vilified 和「找到真理」矛盾；challenge（質疑）語氣太弱，不符合 extreme position。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Before the inflation ______, one could have had a complete meal in a restaurant for five dollars, including the tip, whereas today, a hot dog, coffee, and dessert would ______ add up to two or three times that much.

options.text: spiral
promulgation
criteria
incorrigibly
indubitably
conditionally

explanation: 正確答案為 “spiral”、“indubitably”。「Before the inflation ___」與「whereas today」對比：過去五美元吃一餐，現在簡單小吃就要兩三倍，表示通膨 spiral（螺旋式攀升），而且必然 indubitably（無疑地）加總超過。promulgation（頒布）與 criteria 不能修飾 inflation；conditionally 削弱了肯定語氣。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Some psychologists and educators were adamant about the teaching procedures used at institutions of higher learning. For example, the renowned behaviorist B. F. Skinner believed that those colleges set up to train teachers should ______ change their training philosophy or else be ______.

options.text: voluntarily
drastically
conditionally
investigated
induced
abolished

explanation: 正確答案為 “drastically”、“abolished”。adamant（堅決的）表示 Skinner 態度強硬：師範學院必須「徹底」改變其培訓理念，否則就該被「廢除」。drastically 意為「大幅地」，abolished 意為「廢止」。voluntarily 與 conditionally 語氣太弱；investigated（被調查）不足以作為 or else 的嚴厲後果。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The renowned psychologist B. F. Skinner called his particular brand of behaviorism “Radical Behaviorism.” Skinner did not accept private events such as thinking, personal perceptions, and unobservable ______ in a casual account of an organism’s ______, presumably a self-aware one reporting such ______ as an observer of itself.

options.text: emotions
conditions
premises
structure
behavior
criterion
characteristics
notions
states

explanation: 正確答案為 “emotions”、“behavior”、“states”。前文列 private events 如 thinking、perceptions，第一空同類為 emotions（情緒）；Skinner 解釋的是生物體的 behavior（行為），casual 應為 causal 之誤。第三空回指自我報告的內在 states（狀態）。conditions、premises 不屬 private events；structure 與 criterion 不是行為主義的解釋對象。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The president is ______ to grant federal pardons and reprieves and to convene and adjourn either or both houses of Congress under extraordinary circumstances. Since the founding of the United States, the power of the president and the federal government has substantially grown, and each modern president, despite possessing no formal legislative powers beyond signing or vetoing congressionally passed bills, is largely responsible for ______ the legislative agenda of his party and the foreign and domestic policy of the United States. The president is frequently described as the most ______ person in the world.

options.text: elected
empowered
chosen
supporting
dictating
developing
important
powerful
visible

explanation: 正確答案為 “empowered”、“dictating”、“powerful”。總統依法有權特赦與召集國會，第一空填 empowered（被授權的）；雖然沒有正式立法權，卻在很大程度上 dictating（主導）黨的立法議程，因此常被稱為世上最 powerful（有權力的）的人。supporting 太弱；visible 與權力的主題不符。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The Classical Age of Greek culture ended with the defeat of Athens and Sparta; the ______ effect of the long war was the weakening and ______ of the Greek spirit and the ______ of the creativity of the prominent artists.

options.text: immediate
ironic
cumulative
rebuilding
corrosion
separation
development
ingenuity
stifling

explanation: 正確答案為 “cumulative”、“corrosion”、“stifling”。the long war 是長期戰爭，其影響是 cumulative（累積的）；後兩空皆為負面：希臘精神的 weakening and corrosion（侵蝕），以及藝術家創造力的 stifling（扼殺）。rebuilding 與 development 方向相反；immediate 不符 long war 的長期性。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Their married life was not ______ since it was fraught with bitter fighting and arguments.

options.text: nubile
tranquil
obvious
cogent
imminent

explanation: 正確答案為 tranquil。since 說明原因：婚姻充滿激烈爭吵，所以並不「平靜」，tranquil 意為「寧靜安穩的」，與 bitter fighting 直接相反。nubile（適婚的）、cogent（有說服力的）、imminent（即將發生的）都不能形容婚姻生活的狀態；obvious 也與爭吵無邏輯關係。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The activities that interested Jack were those that provided him with ______ pleasure, like dancing, feasting, and partying.

options.text: questionable
distant
immediate
limited
delayed

explanation: 正確答案為 “immediate”。舉例「dancing, feasting, and partying」都是能立刻享受的樂趣，故為 immediate（立即的）快樂。delayed 與 distant 方向相反；questionable 與 limited 都無法由這些例子推出。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Although Sir Isaac Newton was acclaimed as the forerunner of the development of a viable concept of the law of gravity, Leonardo da Vinci ______ the law of gravity two centuries before Newton and also made the first complete ______ charts of the human body.

options.text: examined
perused
anticipated
anatomical
judicious
scintillating

explanation: 正確答案為 “anticipated”、“anatomical”。Although 表讓步：雖然牛頓被譽為重力定律的先驅，達文西卻早兩個世紀就「預見」了重力定律，還繪製了第一批完整的人體「解剖」圖。anticipated 意為「預見、早於」，anatomical 意為「解剖的」。examined 與 perused 無法凸顯「早於牛頓」的對比。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The salesmen in that clothing store are so ______ that it is impossible to even look at a garment without being ______ by their efforts to convince you to purchase the item.

options.text: impecunious
parsimonious
persistent
harassed
subdued
berated

explanation: 正確答案為 “persistent”、“harassed”。so… that it is impossible to even look at a garment without… 表示店員纏人到看一眼衣服就被糾纏，故第一空為 persistent（堅持不懈、纏人的），第二空為 harassed（被騷擾、糾纏）。impecunious（貧窮）與 parsimonious（吝嗇）與推銷無關；berated（責罵）過強，店員推銷是說服而非責罵；subdued 方向不符。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: In a previous historical and unexpected event, President Anwar el-Sadat of Egypt, disregarding ______ criticism in the Arab world and in his own government, ______ had accepted Prime Minister Menachem Begin’s invitation to visit Israel in order to address the Israeli Knesset.

options.text: acrimonious
categorical
plethoric
audaciously
plaintively
formally

explanation: 正確答案為 “acrimonious”、“formally”。「disregarding…criticism」說明沙達特不顧阿拉伯世界與自己政府的強烈反對，第一空填 acrimonious（尖酸激烈的）。第二空說明接受邀請的方式，formally accepted（正式接受）是常見搭配。audaciously 雖有大膽之意，但不顧批評已表達大膽；plaintively（哀怨地）也不合。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Some teachers can be influenced by the seemingly persuasive tactics used by their students. If a teacher is a truly objective person, he or she will allow neither ______ attempts to please nor open ______ on the part of the student to ______ a judgment of the student’s work.

options.text: unwarranted
condescending
hypocritical
defiance
reliance
understanding
conjure up
diminish
influence

explanation: 正確答案為 “hypocritical”、“defiance”、“influence”。If a teacher is a truly objective person：客觀的老師不會讓學生 hypocritical（虛偽的）討好或公開 defiance（反抗）來 influence（影響）評分。neither…nor 兩者需相反：討好 vs 反抗。reliance、understanding 不構成對立；diminish 只表示貶低，不夠全面。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Can there be any work of Beethoven’s that confirms all this to a higher degree than his indescribably ______ Symphony in C minor? This wonderful composition, in a climax that climbs on and on, imperiously leads the listener forward into the world of ______. No doubt the whole rushes like an ingenious rhapsody past many, but the soul of each thoughtful listener is assuredly stirred, deeply and intimately, by a feeling that is none other than that unutterable ______ longing, and until the final chord—indeed, even in the moments that follow it—the listener will be powerless to step out of that wondrous spirit realm where grief and joy embrace him in the form of sound.

options.text: meticulous
profound
sensitive
complexity
the infinite
the harmonious
portentous
anxious
devastating

explanation: 正確答案為 profound、the infinite、portentous。後文說這首作品深深觸動聽者靈魂，故以「深刻的」（profound）形容 C 小調交響曲。它引領聽者進入超越現實的「無限」（the infinite），呼應後文的 spirit realm。那份 unutterable longing 是「預示不凡、充滿預感的」渴望，portentous 最合浪漫派語境；anxious 與 devastating 過於負面，complexity 也不對應靈界。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: He was ______ about a rise in the value of the stocks he had recently purchased and was eager to make a change in his investment portfolio.

options.text: fearful
unconcerned
hesitant
amused
dubious

explanation: 正確答案為 “dubious”。「was eager to make a change in his investment portfolio」表示他對最近買的股票會不會漲感到懷疑，dubious 意為「懷疑的、不確定的」。unconcerned 與想調整投資組合矛盾；fearful 雖接近，但「害怕上漲」不合邏輯；hesitant 則與 eager 相衝突。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Because the subject matter was so technical, the instructor made every effort to use ______ terminology to describe it.

options.text: candid
simplified
discreet
specialized
involved

explanation: 正確答案為 “simplified”。Because 表因果：因為主題非常技術性，老師才盡力用「簡化的」術語來說明。simplified 意為「簡化的」。specialized（專業的）與 involved（複雜的）正好會讓內容更難懂，與 made every effort 的用意相反。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Although there was considerable ______ among the members of the panel as to the qualities essential for a champion, Sugar Ray Robinson was ______ voted the greatest fighter of all time.

options.text: discourse
disagreement
research
characteristically
overwhelmingly
presumably

explanation: 正確答案為 “disagreement”、“overwhelmingly”。Although 表示讓步：評審之間對冠軍必備特質雖有相當 disagreement（分歧），Sugar Ray Robinson 仍 overwhelmingly（壓倒性地）被選為史上最偉大拳手。discourse 與 research 無法與後半形成對比；presumably（大概）與 characteristically 都無法表現「意見分歧卻一致投票」的轉折力道。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: longtime philosophy professor displayed The extreme stubbornness; not only did he ______ the logic of the student’s argument, but he ______ to acknowledge that the textbook conclusion was correct.

options.text: justify
denigrate
reject
refused
consented
presumed

explanation: 正確答案為 “reject”、“refused”。首句說教授「extreme stubbornness」，分號後以「not only…but」舉例：他不但 reject（拒絕接受）學生論證的邏輯，還 refused（拒絕）承認課本的結論是對的。denigrate（貶低）雖然也通，卻不如 reject 直接；consented 則與固執相反。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Many contenders argue that a sense of fairness ______ that the punishment should fit the crime; however, it is noted that in actual practice, judicial decisions ______ greatly for the same type of criminal offense.

options.text: relegates
dictates
presupposes
vary
emanate
coincide

explanation: 正確答案為 “dictates”、“vary”。a sense of fairness dictates（要求、規定）罰當其罪。however…in actual practice 轉折：實際上同類犯罪的判決 vary（差異很大）。coincide 與 however 方向相反；presupposes 雖可接 that 子句，但語意是「預設」而非「要求」。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Governor Edwards combined ______ politics with administrative skills to dominate the state; in addition to offering these abilities, he was ______ and possessed an air of ______.

options.text: inept
corrupt
astute
charismatic
lavish
creative
elegance
haughtiness
subtleness

explanation: 正確答案為 astute、charismatic、elegance。他結合某種政治手腕與行政能力而「主導」全州，所以必是「精明的」（astute）政治，inept（無能）與 corrupt 都不能說明其成功。in addition to 表示再加上正面特質：他具「領袖魅力」（charismatic），並帶有「優雅」（elegance）的氣質。lavish（奢華）與 haughtiness（傲慢）都偏負面，與一系列優點不協調。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Athens was ruled not by kings and emperors, as was common among other ______ at the time, but by a citizenry that ______ fully in the affairs of the city. It was argued that the conditions and lifestyle in Athens were more ______ to the population because of this type of government.

options.text: populations
societies
cities
coorperated
participated
engaged
alien
detrimental
advantageous

explanation: 正確答案為 “societies”、“participated”、“advantageous”。第一空對應「kings and emperors」，指當時其他 societies（社會）；公民「___ fully in the affairs」為 participated（參與）；「because of this type of government」說明生活更 advantageous（有利）。detrimental 與肯定語氣相反；engaged 語意較弱。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The Prime Minister had stated that Spain would ______ to its decision to bar the United States jet fighters from Spanish soil, despite strong pressure from allies on behalf of our nation.

options.text: yield
return
refer
succumb
adhere

explanation: 正確答案為 “adhere”。despite 盟國的強大壓力，西班牙仍要「堅守」禁止美國戰機的決定。adhere to 意為「堅持、遵守」。yield 與 succumb（屈服）方向相反，與 despite 矛盾；return 與 refer 搭配 to its decision 語意不通。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Steffi Graf, as a West German teenager, ______ pleasures like dancing, feasting, and partying.

options.text: confined
solidified
gladdened
appreciated
forfeited

explanation: 正確答案為 “appreciated”。空格描述 Steffi Graf 青少年時期對舞蹈、宴飲、派對等樂趣的態度，答案 appreciated 表示她「欣賞、享受」這些樂趣。confined、solidified 與 gladdened 都不能以 pleasures 為受詞構成通順語意。不過本句缺乏明確線索，forfeited（放棄）在語法上同樣成立，且更符合她為訓練犧牲青春的形象。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The social-cultural trends of the 1960s ______ not only the relative affluence of the postwar period but also the coming to maturity of a generation that was the product of that ______.

options.text: accentuated
reflected
dominated
prosperity
revolution
movement

explanation: 正確答案為 “reflected”、“prosperity”。六〇年代的社會文化趨勢 reflected（反映）了戰後的相對富裕，以及由「that」所指的 prosperity（繁榮）培育出的一代人。第二空回指「relative affluence」。revolution 與 movement 都無法回指富裕；dominated 也與「product of」的因果關係不合。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: A survey depicted that some people are quite ______ about having a guest remove his shoes before he entered their house; yet the majority of rooms in the houses of those people were found to be ______ at the time the guests visited those houses.

options.text: indifferent
perplexed
adamant
deranged
professional
disorderly

explanation: 正確答案為 “adamant”、“disorderly”。yet 轉折：有些人 adamant（堅持的）要客人脫鞋，但他們的房間卻 disorderly（凌亂的），形成諷刺對比。indifferent 會使 yet 失去意義；deranged 用於形容人精神錯亂，不適合房間。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The rights of citizens include the following: the rights to life, liberty, the pursuit of happiness, and the free exercise of worship. ______ in these rights is the ______ to preserve and defend them to the best of the citizens’ ability.

options.text: Precluded
Implicit
Inherent
principle
opportunity
responsibility

explanation: 正確答案為 Implicit、responsibility。句子先列舉公民的權利，接著說這些權利中「隱含」著某項義務，Implicit in 意為「隱含於……之中」。後面 to preserve and defend them 是公民要盡力去做的事，故為「責任」（responsibility），opportunity 與 principle 不能表達義務。Precluded（被排除的）方向相反；Inherent 雖也通順，但題目以 Implicit 為準。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The discouragement and ______ that so often plague perfectionists can lead to decreases in ______ and production, also often ______ the quality and quantity of the material that is produced.

options.text: frugality
pressure
purposefulness
creativity
development
promotion
affecting
determining
exacting

explanation: 正確答案為 “pressure”、“creativity”、“affecting”。「discouragement and ___ that so often plague perfectionists」須為困擾完美主義者的 pressure（壓力）；它會降低 creativity（創造力）與產出，並 affecting（影響）作品的質與量。frugality 與困擾無關；determining 太強，原文只說「often」。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Originally conceived as a work in progress for a ______ film, Utopia has ______ into a one-of-a-kind show that threads together a century’s worth of dizzying sounds and images into a deeply moving meditation on our world’s ______ shrinking idealism.

options.text: magnanimous
still uncompleted
captivating
transformed
positioned itself
evolved
understandably
ironically
seemingly

explanation: 正確答案為 “still uncompleted”、“evolved”、“seemingly”。Originally 表示最初只是一部「尚未完成」電影的進行中作品，填 still uncompleted；後來它從進行中作品「逐步演變」成獨一無二的演出，填 evolved；世界的理想主義「似乎」正在萎縮，填 seemingly。magnanimous 不能修飾電影，ironically 則缺少反諷線索。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Television is watched so frequently that intellectuals who detest the “tube” are ______, as they believe that because the medium creates ______ among the viewers, many of the viewers get into a mode in their life and work of relying on ______ means of stimulation and entertainment rather than using internal means of attaining knowledge and enjoyment.

options.text: perplexed
disillusioned
infuriated
fervor
an encouragement
a passivity
external
subtle
superficial

explanation: 正確答案為 “infuriated”、“a passivity”、“external”。as they believe 說明知識分子對電視的負面態度，第一空為 infuriated（憤怒的）。電視使觀眾產生 a passivity（被動），進而依賴 external（外在的）刺激，與 rather than using internal means 對照。superficial 雖負面卻無法與 internal 相對；fervor 與 an encouragement 語氣不符。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Because the majority of the evening cable TV programs available dealt with violence and sex, the parents decided that the programs were ______ for the children to watch.

options.text: exclusive
acceptable
instructive
inappropriate
unnecessary

explanation: 正確答案為 “inappropriate”。「Because」表示因果：多數晚間節目充斥暴力與色情，家長因此認為不適合孩子觀看。inappropriate（不合適的）最合適。acceptable 與 instructive 方向相反；unnecessary 語意太弱，沒有反映出內容的問題。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Although the death of his dog had saddened him markedly, his website designing skills remained completely ______.

options.text: twisted
unaffected
incapable
repaired
demolished

explanation: 正確答案為 “unaffected”。Although…saddened him markedly 讓步：狗的死令他悲傷，但網站設計技巧完全 unaffected（未受影響）。demolished、twisted 與 Although 的轉折方向相反；repaired 預設技能曾受損。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: During the postwar period, ______ firms met with great difficulty in maintaining their business as soon as the standard brands of ______ companies became generally available.

options.text: fledgling
manufacturing
specialized
enterprising
established
agricultural

explanation: 正確答案為 fledgling、established。as soon as 表示：一旦某些公司的標準品牌普遍上市，另一些公司就難以維持生意，可見前者是「新興、剛起步的」（fledgling）小公司，後者是「老牌、已站穩腳步的」（established）大公司。enterprising（有進取心的）無法說明品牌普及的優勢；manufacturing 與 specialized 也沒有形成強弱對比。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Much research has shown that a common mistake in our educational jargon is stressing the interests of ______ and eliding over the ______.

options.text: the community
society
the aristocracy
individual
partisans
oligarchy

explanation: 正確答案為 “society”、“individual”。「stressing the interests of ___ and eliding over the ___」是一組對比，教育中常強調 society（社會整體）的利益而略過 individual（個人）。the community 與 society 太接近，若放在不同空格會失去對比；oligarchy 與 aristocracy 和教育脈絡無關。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The student of human nature knows that its components are, for the most part, ______, but the student is also aware that events pleasant or unpleasant do play a part in bringing to the fore at one time or another certain ______.

options.text: multifarious
ephemeral
immutable
reactions
characteristics
instincts

explanation: 正確答案為 “immutable”、“characteristics”。but 表轉折：人性的構成要素大多「不變」，但事件會在不同時候激發出某些「特質」。immutable 意為「不可改變的」，characteristics 意為「特質」。ephemeral（短暫的）與 but 的轉折方向不符；reactions 是事件的結果，而非人性的組成要素。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Even his most ______ backers expressed a feeling of ______ and ______ because of his current inability to complete his assignments in a timely and efficient manner.

options.text: fervent
trusted
proficient
surprise
disappointment
awe
solidarity
disillusionment
remorse

explanation: 正確答案為 “fervent”、“disappointment”、“disillusionment”。Even his most ___ backers 表示連最熱忱的支持者都失望，第一空為 fervent（熱烈的）；因他無法如期完成任務，他們感到 disappointment（失望）與 disillusionment（幻滅）。surprise 不如失望貼合負面因果；remorse（悔恨）屬犯錯者本人的情緒；awe 方向相反。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The dictator’s slow and easy manner and his air of gentility ______ his firm intention to ensure no opposition to his planned ______ policies, and his ______ in carrying out these policies sustained them while he was in office.

options.text: revealed
supported
belied
unique
drastic
revolutionary
determination
manner
craft

explanation: 正確答案為 “belied”、“drastic”、“craft”。從容溫和的外表 belied（掩飾）他壓制反對的堅定意圖，政策應是 drastic（激烈的）；而他推行政策時的 craft（手腕、權謀）使政策得以延續，呼應溫文外表下的心機。revealed 方向相反；determination 雖然可通，卻與溫和外表的反差不夠呼應。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: The profession of a Major League Baseball player involves more than ______ in these times when astronomical salaries and ______ contract bargaining is commonplace; many excellent players now need ______ agents to represent them, whereas many years ago, the players could enter the major leagues and succeed on their own.

options.text: playing skill
practice
enthusiasm
efficient
astute
devious
private
seasoned
audacious

explanation: 正確答案為 “playing skill”、“astute”、“seasoned”。在高薪與 astute（精明的）合約談判普遍的時代，球員職業不只需要 playing skill（球技），還需要 seasoned（經驗豐富的）經紀人。devious（狡詐）帶貶義，與常態化談判不符；audacious agents 不是後文強調的老練。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Volkswagen, the first foreign automobile company to build cars in the United States, at one time announced that because of ______ sales, it had decided to close several of its plants in the United States.

options.text: exclusive
indescribable
astounding
interesting
sluggish

explanation: 正確答案為 sluggish。because of 說明關廠原因，只有銷售「低迷、遲緩」才會導致關閉工廠，sluggish 即「不景氣的」。astounding（驚人的）通常暗示好業績，與關廠矛盾；exclusive、indescribable、interesting 都無法提供合理的因果。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Gogh’s painting Van Irises, which was auctioned off for $53 million, failed to create ______ among several art critics when it was first shown in Paris a hundred years ago.

options.text: animosity
disparity
enthusiasm
ambiguity
indifference

explanation: 正確答案為 “enthusiasm”。「auctioned off for $53 million」與「failed to create ___」形成反差：如今價值連城，當年卻沒有在評論家間引起 enthusiasm（熱情）。animosity 與 indifference 用在 failed to create 之後會變成正面意思，與反差不符。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: When he saw his brother approach, he ______; he was sorry to have made such a show of his true feelings. He would have given much to have been able to suppress his ______ at that moment.

options.text: grimaced
exulted
beckoned
fervor
deliverance
expression

explanation: 正確答案為 “grimaced”、“expression”。分號後說他後悔把真實感受表露得這麼明顯，因此他見到兄弟時「露出痛苦的表情」，填 grimaced；他很想壓抑當時的「表情」，填 expression。exulted（狂喜）與 sorry 矛盾；fervor（熱情）與 deliverance 都不符合前後文的「臉部表露」。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: At the trial, the defendant maintained a manner that could best be described as ______, but the revelations concerning his actions in the commission of the crime portrayed a personality that could only be described as ______.

options.text: sanctimonious
impassive
continent
impassioned
imperious
jocose

explanation: 正確答案為 “impassive”、“impassioned”。but 表示對比：被告在審判時的態度是 impassive（面無表情、冷漠的），但其犯案行為顯示的性格卻是 impassioned（激情衝動的）。sanctimonious（假裝虔誠）與 continent（自制的）無法與後半形成冷靜/激動的對比；imperious（專橫）與 jocose（詼諧）也不是 impassive 的對立面。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Although some politicians believe that crime is decreasing, the government indicated after unbiased research that the crime rate in the United States remains ______ and that one in every three households ______ some form of major crime in any year.

options.text: elevated
incredible
stagnant
initiates
experiences
anticipates

explanation: 正確答案為 “elevated”、“experiences”。「Although some politicians believe that crime is decreasing」表示轉折：政府研究顯示犯罪率仍然 elevated（偏高），每三戶就有一戶 experiences（遭遇）重大犯罪。stagnant（停滯的）沒有說明高低；initiates 與 anticipates 都不符合受害的語意。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: You can turn on the television and on a news program ______ view some piece of news that deals with a crime. In fact, violent crime has become so ______ in our cities throughout the country that hardly a day goes by when we are not made aware of some ______ acts.

options.text: possibly
no doubt
probably
prevalent
spectacular
vicious
destructive
heinous
well carried out

explanation: 正確答案為 “probably”、“prevalent”、“heinous”。第一空 probably 以適度推測語氣描述新聞常見犯罪，後句 In fact 再加強：暴力犯罪在城市如此 prevalent（普遍），幾乎每天都會得知某些 heinous（令人髮指的）行為。spectacular 與 vicious 不能說明「每天都見到」；well carried out 與批評語氣不合。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Education was different many years ago. Now, despite a rising tide of ______ in public education, there are some people who are examples of informed a ______ teachers—a blessing to children and ______ to education.

options.text: specialization
superfluousness
mediocrity
knowledgeable
sophisticated
dedicated
an asset
a detriment
a revelation

explanation: 正確答案為 mediocrity、dedicated、an asset。despite 表示對比：公共教育雖充斥「平庸」（mediocrity），仍有一些見識豐富且「盡心投入的」（dedicated）教師。他們是孩子的福氣，也是教育的「資產」（an asset），與 a blessing 並列為正面。specialization 不構成負面對比；a detriment（損害）方向相反；a revelation 與 to education 搭配不自然。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Gestalt school of psychology emphasizes that the mind tends to ______ and organize activities in ______ wholes. The best example of this is experiencing a single ______ and not simply a mass of blue points when you look at an unbroken expanse in the sky.

options.text: perceive
structure
envelop
integrated
secular
exact
point
impression
relationship

explanation: 正確答案為 “perceive”、“integrated”、“impression”。Gestalt 學派主張心智傾向 perceive（感知）並把活動組織成 integrated（整合的）整體；例子是看天空時看到單一的 impression（整體印象），而非一堆藍點。point 正好是「mass of blue points」中的個別單位，方向相反；secular 與整體性無關。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Knowing about the past cannot help people to make important decisions today.
explanation: 請提出明確立場，以具體理由與例證支援論點，並處理可能的限制、反例或相反觀點。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: College students should be encouraged to pursue subjects that interest them rather than the courses that seem most likely to lead to jobs.
explanation: 請提出明確立場，以具體理由與例證支援論點，並處理可能的限制、反例或相反觀點。

source.title: Gruber's Complete GRE Guide · authorized copy

prompt: Claim: Imagination is a more valuable asset than experience. Reason: People who lack experience are free to imagine what is possible without the constraints of established habits and attitudes.
explanation: 請提出明確立場，以具體理由與例證支援論點，並處理可能的限制、反例或相反觀點。
